capabilities: Open the bb IDE as an Obsidian tab or sidebar panel
Launch the bb desktop app when its local server is not responding
Set provider, model, and permission-mode defaults for the bb project matching the current vault
Zoom the embedded bb view from 50% to 200%
disambiguation: Not an AI agent running inside Obsidian; it only embeds the external bb desktop app's web interface.
extras: README includes reviewer notes disclosing shell execution (child_process) for launching bb and writing bb's SQLite database, plus clipboard access limited to copying an install command; states it makes no remote network requests. Install command shown: npx bb-app@latest. Desktop-only.
motivation: For people who already use bb, so they can open its UI inside Obsidian; the plugin explicitly has no functionality of its own.
problem: Using bb requires switching to its separate desktop app instead of working with it alongside vault notes in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Embeds bb — a local AI agentic IDE with a desktop app — inside an Obsidian tab

summary: Wrapper that embeds the bb AI agentic IDE's local web interface inside an Obsidian tab or sidebar.
